iris.shaders.debug.enabled.en: Debugging has been enabled, debug logging will be more verbose!
iris.shaders.debug.enabled.zh: 调试已启用，日志将更加详细！

iris.shaders.debug.failure.en: Cannot enable debugging, your computer does not support debug features.
iris.shaders.debug.failure.zh: 无法启用调试，你的电脑不支持调试功能。

iris.shaders.debug.restart.en: You do not have a debug context, please restart to enable OpenGL client debugging.
iris.shaders.debug.restart.zh: 没有调试环境，请重启以启用调试。

iris.load.failure.shader.en: The shaderpack failed to load! Please report the error to the shader developer.

iris.load.failure.generic.en: Oculus encountered an issue trying to load the shader; please report this to Oculus developers.

iris.shaders.ssbofailure.en: The shader requested a specific feature (SSBO) that is not supported by your GPU, it may not work correctly.
iris.shaders.ssbofailure.zh: 光影请求了你的 GPU 所不支持的特定功能（SSBO），可能无法正常工作。

iris.shaders.reloaded.failure.zh: 重新加载光影包失败！原因：%s

iris.sodium.failure.reason.notFound.en: Oculus requires Rubidium for good performance, but Rubidium is not installed. Please download Rubidium, place it in your mods folder, and re-launch the game.
iris.sodium.failure.reason.notFound.zh: Oculus 需要 Rubidium 来提供更好的性能，但你并没有安装 Rubidium。请下载 Rubidium，把它放到 mods 文件夹中，并重新启动游戏。

iris.sodium.failure.reason.incompatible.en: Oculus requires Rubidium for good performance, but an incompatible version was found. Please download the correct version of Rubidium, place it in your mods folder, remove the incorrect version, and re-launch the game.
iris.sodium.failure.reason.incompatible.zh: Oculus 需要 Rubidium 来提供更好的性能，但不兼容已安装的 Rubidium 版本。请下载正确的 Rubidium 版本，把它放到 mods 文件夹中，移除错误的 Rubidium 版本，并重新启动游戏。

iris.nec.failure.description.en:
Not Enough Crashes can severely break the game while handling crashes, and does not provide accurate results.
A good alternative is MixinTrace, which can identify the cause of a crash more reliably and does not put the game in an invalid state.
iris.nec.failure.description.zh:
在处理崩溃时，Not Enough Crashes 会严重破坏游戏，而且无法提供准确的结果。
好的替代品有 MixinTrace，它们都可以更准确地识别崩溃原因并且不会使游戏处于无效状态。

iris.unsupported.pack.description.en: The shaderpack you are trying to load contains features unsupported by %s. Please try another pack. List %s
iris.unsupported.pack.description.zh: 你尝试加载的光影包含%s不支持的功能。请尝试其他光影。名单：%s

iris.unsupported.pack.macos.en: macOS is known to have issues with many shader packs.
iris.unsupported.pack.macos.zh: macOS 已知与很多光影包都有兼容性问题。

options.iris.shaderPackSelection.failedA.en: Files were not valid Shader Packs
options.iris.shaderPackSelection.failedA.zh: 文件不是有效的光影包

options.iris.shaderPackSelection.failedA.en: "%s" is not a valid Shader Pack

options.iris.shaderPackSelection.copyErr.en: "%s" is already in your Shader Packs folder!

options.iris.shaderPackOptions.tooManyFi.en: Cannot import multiple Shader Settings files!
options.iris.shaderPackOptions.tooManyFi.zh: 无法导入多个光影设置文件！

options.iris.shaderPackOptions.failedImp.en: Failed to import Shader Settings file "%s"
options.iris.shaderPackOptions.failedImp.zh: 导入光影设置文件“%s”失败

options.iris.reset.tooltip.holdShift.en: Hold SHIFT and click to reset
options.iris.reset.tooltip.holdShift.zh: 按住 SHIFT 点击以重置

options.iris.exportSettings.tooltip.zh: 将应用的设置导出至文件

options.iris.shadowDistance.enabled.en: Allows you to change the maximum distance for shadows. Terrain and entities beyond this distance will not cast shadows. Lowering the shadow distance can significantly increase performance.
options.iris.shadowDistance.enabled.zh: 允许更改阴影的最远距离。超出此距离的地形和实体不会投射阴影。降低阴影距离可以显著提高性能。

options.iris.shadowDistance.disabled.en: Your current shader pack has already set a render distance for shadows; you cannot change it.
options.iris.shadowDistance.disabled.zh: 你不能改变当前的光影包已经为阴影设置的渲染距离。

options.iris.shadowDistance.sodium_toolt.en: The shadow render distance controls how far away terrain can potentially be rendered in the shadow pass. Lower distances mean that less terrain will be rendered, improving frame rates. This option cannot be changed on packs which explicitly specify a shadow render distance. The actual shadow render distance is capped by the View Distance setting.
options.iris.shadowDistance.sodium_toolt.zh: 阴影渲染距离控制在阴影通道中可以渲染到多远的地形。更短的距离意味着将渲染更少的地形，从而提高帧率。在明确指定了阴影渲染距离的光影包上无法更改此选项。实际阴影渲染的距离受“渲染距离”设置的限制。

options.iris.colorSpace.sodium_tooltip.en: The color space to transform the screen to. Works on top of shader packs. Use SRGB if unsure.

pack.iris.list.label.en: + Drag and Drop Shader Packs to add
pack.iris.list.label.zh: + 拖放光影包至此以添加
